description: Boeing 737-230(A) c/n 22122/721, first flown 4 February 1981 as D-ABFN for Lufthansa, later VT-MGC, N124NJ, CC-CDL, LV-BCD and CC-CTF (Sky Airline); bought by the FAB in May 2013 as FAB-116 for TAM. Trucked 42 km from Cochabamba airport to Cliza in October 2018 by Inbolpack and set up as a municipal library aircraft; photographed in use as a library 19 January 2023 (Aerospotter).
aliases: 737-230; 737200; 737-200; B737; D-ABFN; CC-CTF; LV-BCD; c/n 22122; Biblioavión
